name: Caption Studio
tagline: Product descriptions, captions and hashtags in your brand's voice.
description:
Caption Studio writes sales copy for small shops and creators. Save your brand voice once, snap or describe a product, pick the platforms, and get several ready-to-post variants with hashtags.

**What it does**

- Start from a photo: drop in a product photo and the AI fills in the product name and the details it can see. It never guesses sizes, prices or materials.
- Brand profiles: voice, audience, words to avoid, emoji style — saved and reused for every text.
- Platforms: shop product description, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn and X, each written to its own length and style.
- Every variant shows its length against the platform limit, with one-click copy.
- Share in one click: pre-filled posts for X and LinkedIn; copy-and-open for Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest.
- Quick rewrites per variant: shorter, longer, warmer, or a stronger call to action. Shorter and Longer always move in the right direction and stop at sensible limits for each platform.
- App in English, German, Chinese, Russian and Hindi; copy in 14 languages; a history of your last results.

**Who it's for**

Etsy, Shopify and marketplace sellers, social media managers and freelancers who write product copy every day.
